name: MSE 4005
title: Processing of Materials in the Liquid and Vapor State
description: Fundamental principles of materials processing and their quantitative application to process design will be illustrated for materials processes involving liquids and gasses: crystal growth, zone refining, shape casting, continuous casting, refining, welding, and vapor deposition.
requirement_description: MSE 3001 and 3002, both may be taken concurrently.
